decisions.after: Guan Zhong’s seventy-two rulers, counted through the generations named here, yield barely twenty-odd lords—Fuxi, Shennong, Nüwa, Dating, Baihuang, Zhongyang, Lilu, Lilian, Hexu, Zunlu, Hundun, Haoying, Youchao, Zhuxiang, Getian, Yinkang, Wuhuai, the Yellow Emperor, Shaohao, Zhuanxu, Gaoxin, Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu—with Gonggong in between, a hegemon of the Nine Provinces not counted among the emperors: whence seventy-two Feng-and-Shan kings?
decisions.reason: The source does list the twenty-odd names, but 此中世數 is the count of generations in that list, not “middle antiquity.”
